review_subject: Claude-developed process docs, wiki, HTML, git history, simulation code, tests, artifacts, and engineering reports

baselines.comparison_head: 391ce20 feat(exp011): 新增铁损模型和Bertotti三相铁损速度扫描实验

findings.title: codex-review-line and claude-mainline have diverged and need an explicit integration strategy
findings.recommended_action: Choose whether to migrate this review package and PyFluent workflow to claude-mainline, merge claude-mainline back, or keep branches isolated with explicit factual boundaries.

findings.title: Tests and runners write tracked artifacts with absolute paths or timestamps
findings.recommended_action: Make ordinary tests write to tmp_path or explicit output paths; keep tracked artifact regeneration behind dedicated update commands; store summary paths as repository-relative paths.

findings.title: combined_losses returns iron-loss fraction while documenting efficiency_percent
findings.recommended_action: Rename the return value to iron_loss_fraction or compute real efficiency from mechanical output power; update tests to assert the corrected semantics.

findings.title: Bertotti freq_max_hz is declared but not enforced
findings.recommended_action: Flag, reject, or summarize points where freq_hz exceeds coeffs.freq_max_hz; keep high-speed EXP-011 results clearly marked as outside coefficient validity.

findings.title: EXP-011 iron_loss_vs_copper_loss_ratio mixes average iron loss with first-point copper loss
findings.recommended_action: Compute ratio using matching statistics, such as avg_iron_loss_target divided by avg_copper_loss_target, or report per-point ratio aggregates.

findings.title: Flux LUT search does not validate consistency with MotorParams
findings.recommended_action: Validate params.pole_pairs against flux_lut.pole_pairs and add source, motor id, temperature, and coordinate convention fields to LUT metadata.

findings.title: Human-facing Claude docs need to catch up with control LUT and EXP-011
findings.recommended_action: Update README, handoff, evidence manifest, simulation traceability, wiki, HTML, and snapshots to include control LUT and EXP-011 while preserving proxy-model limitations.

findings.title: Wiki and HTML matrices can still propagate stale experiment numbering
findings.recommended_action: Regenerate or manually update active wiki and HTML to EXP-001 through EXP-011, then refresh snapshots and manifest hashes.

findings.title: .claude local agent directory and worktrees need isolation
findings.recommended_action: Ignore .claude/ by default or extract only intentional long-lived workflow files; exclude .claude/worktrees from routine review searches.

findings.title: PyFluent workflow exists only on codex-review-line and needs a mainline decision
findings.recommended_action: Review and cherry-pick PyFluent workflow into claude-mainline, or explicitly document it as a codex-review-line candidate outside current Claude mainline facts.

next_steps: Add automated checks so ordinary pytest does not leave tracked summary, CSV, or control LUT diffs.
Fix iron loss API semantics and Bertotti frequency validity handling before relying on EXP-011 for ranking.
Synchronize Claude docs, wiki, HTML, snapshots, and manifests to control LUT and EXP-011.
Decide the branch integration path for PyFluent and the 2026-05-15 review package.
